description: Evaluates Stage 1 User Goals Portfolio & Journey Prioritization

evals.prompt: I am building an airline ticketing website. Help me create my portfolio of user goals for WebMCP.
evals.expected_output: Prioritized candidate user goals with defined outcomes, required context, and boundaries for each goal.
assertions: The agent proposes prioritized candidate user goals (such as flight search, seat selection, booking, or check-in)
The agent defines outcomes, required context, or boundaries for each proposed goal

evals.prompt: We identified 5 user goals for our app (search products, view cart, checkout, apply coupon, track order). Can you simulate and role-play all 5 goals in bulk in a single turn right now?
evals.expected_output: The agent enforces the "One Goal Per Iteration" rule, refusing to generate role-plays for all 5 goals in bulk. It explains that the full design cycle (Stages 2–4: starting states, turn-by-turn simulation, variations, and active user critique) must be completed for one single goal at a time to explore conversational ambiguity, verify agent demeanor, and establish autonomous confirmation boundaries with the developer.
assertions: The agent enforces completing one goal per iteration (or refuses generating multiple goals in bulk in a single turn)
The agent explains that each goal requires state modeling, role-play simulation, variations, or user critique before moving to the next
The agent mentions soliciting user critique on agent demeanor, clarifying questions, or autonomous confirmation boundaries
